bicycle.definition: a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals

car.definition: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

motorcycle.definition: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame

airplane.definition: an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

bus.definition: a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport

train.definition: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

truck.definition: an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling

boat.definition: a small vessel for travel on water

traffic light.definition: a visual signal to control the flow of traffic at intersections

fire hydrant.definition: an upright hydrant for drawing water to use in fighting a fire

parking meter.definition: a coin-operated timer located next to a parking space; depositing money into it entitles you to park your car there for a specified length of time

bench.definition: a long seat for more than one person

bird.definition: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

cat.definition: feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats

dog.definition: a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

horse.definition: solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

sheep.definition: woolly usually horned ruminant mammal related to the goat

bear.definition: massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws

zebra.definition: any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines

giraffe.definition: tallest living quadruped; having a spotted coat and small horns and very long neck and legs; of savannahs of tropical Africa

backpack.definition: a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder

handbag.definition: a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)

tie.definition: equality of score in a contest

suitcase.definition: a portable rectangular container for carrying clothes

frisbee.definition: a light, plastic disk about 10 inches in diameter; propelled with a flip of the wrist for recreation or competition

skis.definition: narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow

snowboard.definition: a board that resembles a broad ski or a small surfboard; used in a standing position to slide down snow-covered slopes

kite.definition: a bank check that has been fraudulently altered to increase its face value

baseball bat.definition: an implement used in baseball by the batter

baseball glove.definition: the handwear used by fielders in playing baseball

skateboard.definition: a board with wheels that is ridden in a standing or crouching position and propelled by foot

surfboard.definition: a narrow buoyant board for riding surf

tennis racket.definition: a racket used to play tennis

bottle.definition: a glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped

cup.definition: a small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle

fork.definition: cutlery used for serving and eating food

knife.definition: edge tool used as a cutting instrument; has a pointed blade with a sharp edge and a handle

spoon.definition: a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food

bowl.definition: a round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids

banana.definition: any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits

apple.definition: fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh

sandwich.definition: two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them

orange.definition: round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees

broccoli.definition: plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds

carrot.definition: deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant

hot dog.definition: someone who performs dangerous stunts to attract attention to himself

pizza.definition: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese

cake.definition: a block of solid substance (such as soap or wax)

chair.definition: a seat for one person, with a support for the back

couch.definition: a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer

bed.definition: a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep

dining table.definition: a table at which meals are served

toilet.definition: a room or building equipped with one or more toilets

tv.definition: broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects; ;  - Ernie Kovacs

laptop.definition: a portable computer small enough to use in your lap

mouse.definition: any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails

remote.definition: a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance

keyboard.definition: device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like

cell phone.definition: call up by using a cellular phone

microwave.definition: a short electromagnetic wave (longer than infrared but shorter than radio waves); used for radar and microwave ovens and for transmitting telephone, facsimile, video and data

oven.definition: kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting

toaster.definition: someone who proposes a toast; someone who drinks to the health of success of someone or some venture

sink.definition: plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe

refrigerator.definition: white goods in which food can be stored at low temperatures

book.definition: a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)

clock.definition: a timepiece that shows the time of day

vase.definition: an open jar of glass or porcelain used as an ornament or to hold flowers

scissors.definition: an edge tool having two crossed pivoting blades

teddy bear.definition: plaything consisting of a child's toy bear (usually plush and stuffed with soft materials)

hair drier.definition: a hand-held electric blower that can blow warm air onto the hair; used for styling hair

toothbrush.definition: small brush; has long handle; used to clean teeth
